title: Did Academic Research Kill the Anomalies?

anomalies.label: 12-Month Momentum
anomalies.description: Ranks stocks by their return from months t−12 through t−1, the prior 12 months.

anomalies.label: Accruals
anomalies.description: Ranks firms by accruals, an accounting measure based on changes in balance-sheet items relative to average assets.

anomalies.label: Asset Growth
anomalies.description: Ranks firms by the annual growth rate of their total assets.

anomalies.label: Book-to-Market (BM)
anomalies.description: Ranks firms by book-to-market: accounting book equity relative to market equity.

anomalies.label: Initial Public Offerings (IndIPO)
anomalies.description: Flags firms that went public 6 to 36 months earlier; it is a firm-level IPO signal, not an industry-wide measure.
